ai.h1: Your AI can read Lebanese law here. Now it can ask, too.
ai.lead: Search on this site writes a short answer to real questions, only from our own texts and with a link to each source. For your own assistant there is a free MCP server and a JSON API, so it can search the library and read the exact text back to you.
ai.what_p1: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets an AI assistant call tools on a server instead of guessing from training data. Connect one here and it can search this library, open a law, read one article's exact text (Arabic and French, as the Lebanese University's Centre for Research and Studies in Legal Informatics published it), and walk the citation graph between texts.
ai.what_p2: The MCP tools and the API never rewrite a law. Every text they return is copied from the database, the same text the pages on this site show. The answer box on the search page is different: Gemini writes it from passages of our texts, links every source, and can be wrong. Anything an AI tells you beyond the text can be wrong. Check the article it cites, and the Official Gazette, before relying on it.
ai.server_p1: One address, no account, no key:
ai.server_p2: It speaks Streamable HTTP, stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 (MCP protocol version 2025-06-18; 2025-03-26 also works). No sign-in, no session to keep open. It runs on Cloudflare: a Worker in front, and the same Go server and PostgreSQL database that answer the site's search, in a Cloudflare Container. The code is open on GitHub.
ai.claude_p: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. Name it "Lebanese Legislation" and paste the URL above.
ai.chatgpt_p: Settings → Connectors (or Settings → Apps & Connectors → Advanced → Developer mode on a paid plan) → Add connector, same URL.

ai.tool_article_desc: one article's verbatim text, status, amendment history and source.
ai.tool_texts_desc: all of a law's article texts in order, a page at a time, for reading or comparing a whole code.
ai.tool_ruling_desc: one court ruling, with its scanned judgment and, once read, a machine reading of it (it may contain errors; the scan is the reference).
ai.tool_gazette_desc: one Official Gazette issue and what it published.
ai.tool_links_desc: the graph edges into or out of a law, article, ruling, opinion, research study or Gazette issue, for walking citations and amendments directly.
ai.tool_affected_desc: the general repeals that may touch a law, a list to check, never a finding that anything was actually repealed.
ai.every_result: Every result carries this site's own address for that law, article, ruling or issue, the Centre's own source page when known, and the not-legal-advice line.
ai.tool_list_desc: laws, decrees and decisions by date, newest first (the Gazette date, else the issue date), with since, until, kind, order, limit and offset. Texts read from Gazette scans are included.
ai.tool_list_gazette_desc: Official Gazette issues by date, each with its number of texts and its source: the Centre, or the scans for recent issues.
ai.list_p: Everything published since January 2025: since=2025-01. since and until take YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Up to 100 a page; follow next_offset while it is there. The MCP tools list_legislation and list_gazette_issues take the same parameters.
ai.links_p: get_links takes offset, order (newest or oldest) and, for a law, scope: "all" (the default) adds the links of its articles, "law" is the law alone. It answers with total and next_offset.
ai.amended_p: In get_law and /api/v1/law/{id}/, amended_by and amended list each text with its relation, its date and articles: the articles of this law it changes (of the other text, for amended). No articles means the change is to the text as a whole.
ai.openapi_p: The whole API, every endpoint, parameter and field, as an OpenAPI 3.1 description for code generators and AI agents:
ai.updated_p: updated_at is the day a record's page last changed on this site: an amendment in force, a ruling's reading, a correction. It is never the text's own date, and it is absent when we do not know it.
ai.json_api_p: The same data, over plain HTTP, for anything that isn't an MCP client:
ai.limit_1: 60 calls a minute per address, and at most 30 in any 10 seconds at Cloudflare's edge. Past that, a 429.
ai.limit_3: Search results, 20 at a time at most.
ai.limit_4: Every legal text is verbatim from the database. No tool paraphrases or summarizes a law.
ai.limit_5: Not legal advice. Official texts from the Lebanese University's Centre for Research and Studies in Legal Informatics.

about.h1: A public library of Lebanese law.
about.lead: Free to read, free to search, free to build on.
about.desc: Where the texts on Lebanese Legislation come from, what is included, and who makes it: a free public library of Lebanese law.
about.sources_p: Every text here comes from the Lebanese University's Centre for Research and Studies in Legal Informatics (%s), which has catalogued Lebanese legislation, case law and doctrine since 1986. Each page links to the Centre's own record.
about.what_p: %s laws, decrees and decisions, %s of them with their full text so far (%s articles); %s court rulings; %s issues of the Official Gazette; %s legal opinions; %s agreements; and %s articles from legal periodicals. Each of the others is listed with its number, date and title and links to the Centre's record. A nightly update adds new texts and changes from the Centre.
about.not_p: Information from published official texts, not legal advice. The Official Gazette remains the authoritative text: check it, or consult a qualified lawyer for your case. No lawyer or law firm reviews, endorses or stands behind this site.
about.privacy_p1: We count visits with Google Analytics, which sets cookies, to learn which texts people read and how they find them. We also use PostHog, which sets a cookie and keeps the IP address, the pages opened, what is searched and, for some visits, a recording of the page while it is used, so we can see what works and fix what breaks; email addresses typed into the sign-up form are left out of those recordings. We do not run ads, sell data or ask you to sign in. Please do not search for personal information. Search can send your question and selected source passages to the answer provider named next to the search form. Leave out personal details.
about.hosting_p: Cloudflare provides caching, security and operational performance measurement, including its existing browser performance beacon. These hosting measurements run separately from Google Analytics and PostHog browser measurement. Our own server keeps anonymous search words, result counts and document-read totals for up to 90 days, without IP addresses or visitor profiles. Server error monitoring sends a generic error category without query strings, IP addresses, user agents or exception text.
about.journal_p: Read dated updates about public access, data releases and developer tools in the project journal.
about.who_p: A public-service project of Taktek, LLC, built on the Centre for Legal Informatics' published catalogue.

about.infrastructure_p: Cloudflare serves about 760,000 static pages and ruling PDFs from R2 through a JavaScript Worker. Search pages, the API, filters and Gazette scans go to one Cloudflare Container with PostgreSQL 18.6 and the Go website server. Semantic search vectors are stored in Cloudflare Vectorize and published openly on Hugging Face.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.desc: The short rules for using Lebanese Legislation, its data, API and MCP server: free to use, and not legal advice.

terms.advice_p: The texts come from the Lebanese University's Centre for Research and Studies in Legal Informatics. We work to keep them complete and correct, but they can contain errors or be out of date, and the Official Gazette is the authoritative text. Nothing here is legal advice, and Taktek, LLC is not liable for decisions made on the basis of this site. Check the Gazette or ask a qualified lawyer.
terms.reuse_p: You may read, search, link to, copy and reuse the texts and datasets under %sthe database's licence and credit terms%s. Do not present the site's texts as an official publication.
terms.api_p: The API and the MCP server are free. Do not overload them: we limit requests per client and may block traffic that harms the service for others. They come as they are, with no promise that they are always available.
terms.changes_p: We may update these terms, and the date below shows the last change. Questions: write to %s.
